title: Business Information Worker
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Business Information Worker - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Demonstrate computer literacy with respect to computer hardware and software applications.
Apply standard rules of business conduct and customer service.
Develop specialized keyboarding skills at an employable level of accuracy and speed.
Use word processing, spreadsheet, presentation graphics, and scheduling software to perform business and office tasks.
Apply oral and written communication skills in various business and office environments.
Design, modify, query, and manipulate lists (database and information in workbooks using common formulas, data and what if scenario tools to organize and convey information.

notes: The page prints one combined section for the A.S. degree and the Certificate of Achievement; the single requirements list (19 units) and the Program Learning Outcomes are shared by both awards and recorded here for the certificate.
Each 'Choose one course' group pairs cross-listed CAT/CIS twins (same title and units), recorded as one entry with an alternative.

CAT-93 (Computers for Beginners) is printed directly after the 'Choose one course 3.00' group of CAT-90 OR CIS-90, with no OR before it. It is recorded as a separate required course because the stated 19-unit total equals the sum only if CAT-93 is required (otherwise 16). Reviewer should confirm whether CAT-93 is instead a third choice in that group.
CAT-90, CIS-90, CAT-93, CAT-98A and CAT-98B are not in the closed list and are marked as catalog additions.
The outcome beginning 'Design, modify, query...' is copied as printed, including the unclosed parenthesis.
